Type: Region
First Visited: Session 0

Description

A minor but strategically placed county between @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} county and the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale}.
Ruled by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow}.
Deeply entwined with the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}.
Its capital is @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}.
Once an independent kingdom called Aurelion, it was absorbed by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beacon Hold} during the kingdom's expansion after the fracturing of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.BgvmBR3xqE7I4SUZ]{Middle Kingdoms}.

Notable Features

  • Strategically positioned between the capital and the Ashen Vale
  • The Count is a major donor to the Church, with several sons in influential clerical positions
  • The Aureate (Count Marrow's soldiers) patrol the roads and enforce official orders, including a crackdown against bards and storytellers ordered by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.v85bRcnzMrFiDdn6]{The Nodrum} is located deep in the county, not far from @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion} — The capital city
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — The kingdom and capital county it borders
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.luKOvcjkjHGprDBX]{Ashen Vale} — The region to the south

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.8DkFLtD2kUwDvf0s]{Count Albrecht Marrow} — Ruler of Marrow County
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane} — Seneschal to Count Marrow
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.w4Jmvexupl7JI1Wo]{Captain Eisen Dorn} — Captain of the guard in Aurelion
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Luminary Severin Morrow} — Head priest of the church in Aurelion; Marrow's third son

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as Marrow's domain
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2} — The party witnessed signs of ruin spreading: rotting merchant stock, failing crops; the Aureate dragged performers from taverns under the anti-storyteller decree
